svg.text: Wires that cross without a dot are not connected. Dots mark rail connections. All grounds are common, including the pump supply. Never power the pump from the Pico.
GP29 / ADC3 reads VSYS through the Pico's on-board divider (no wire needed). Relay: active-LOW by default (USE_RELAY_GND_ON). Check it accepts a 3.3 V input.
